Aaron and Sarah Kramer

Aaron and Sarah Kramer began their journey with Mission Aviation Fellowship in 2012. Along with their daughters, they served in Indonesia until 2018. After their base closed, they returned to the U.S. and settled near Moody Aviation where they engaged students through events, Bible studies, and discipleship training. In mid-2023, seeking to rekindle his technical skills, Aaron resumed work as a pilot and aircraft technician locally while the family continued to invest in others. In 2024, MAF invited them back to full-time ministry, this time with Mercy Air in South Africa, focusing on exploring future models for ministry, relational discipleship, and global impact.


God calls the men and women of MAF to serve Him in unique ways. He may also be calling you to a special role in the Aaron and Sarah Kramer's ministry. Please prayerfully consider becoming a ministry partner with them through prayer and/or financial support.

Support Aaron and Sarah Kramer's Ministry


MAF missionaries raise support for a pooled fund out of which MAF covers salary, housing, benefits, and staff-related ministry expenses. MAF exercises discretion over the use of missionary support in the exercise of its mission and care of its staff.
